name: Plane Tarrier
body:
You have just broken into this plane from the Twixt, the place between worlds, and its power still glows within you.

Prerequisite(s): Ouphe; must be taken at 1st level

Benefit(s): As a swift action, you may consider all your mutations as enhanced for 1d3 rounds. You may use this ability a number of times per day equal to your Constitution bonus.
